academic.passage: Photosynthesis is a vital process carried out by green plants, algae, and some bacteria. It transforms light energy into chemical energy stored in glucose. This occurs in two main stages: the light-dependent reactions and the Calvin cycle. In the first stage, sunlight is captured and used to produce ATP and NADPH. During the Calvin cycle, ATP and NADPH are utilized to convert carbon dioxide into glucose. This process is crucial for life on Earth as it provides the primary energy source for nearly all ecosystems.

questions.q: What is the main idea of the passage?
options: Photosynthesis is vital for life on Earth.
The Calvin cycle occurs in photosynthesis.
Light energy is transformed into chemical energy.
questions.explain: 這段落的主要思想是光合作用對於地球上的生命至關重要。

questions.explain: 文中提到的光合作用的兩個主要階段是光依賴反應和卡爾文循環。

questions.q: What can be inferred about the role of glucose in ecosystems?
options: It is a waste product of photosynthesis.
It serves as a primary energy source for many organisms.
It is not essential for plant survival.
It is only produced by algae.
questions.explain: 可以推斷，葡萄糖是許多生物的主要能源來源，這對生態系統至關重要。
ATP代表腺苷三磷酸，是能量的主要儲存形式。
